bio: With his Weinstube (or wine tavern), Christian Beck, son of the owner of the hotel and restaurant Heiligenstein, also located in Neuweier near Baden-Baden, has brought a new layer of culinary enrichment to the village. The cuisine here comprises regional, seasonal and Mediterranean dishes. Vegetarian dishes and small bites are also available. Regional wines are offered. Friendly service in a cosy interior that blends tradition and modernity. The terrace is also lovely....
